name: Member Share Balance / Status Lookup
description: Signs on to the Meridian Core servicing console with the supplied operator credentials, searches Member Inquiry by member number, opens the member record, and reads one named share's Balance, Status and Type from the SHARES / BALANCES grid. Read-only: performs no transfer, hold, share opening or member maintenance. Returns shareBalance (money), shareStatus (e.g. OPEN or "HOLD [HOLD]") and shareType (e.g. Regular Shares, Share Draft (Checking), Money Market, Certificate). If the member number does not exist the run reports the business outcome member_not_found instead of values.

inputs.name: operatorId
inputs.description: Operator sign-on id for the servicing console (e.g. a teller id).

inputs.name: operatorPassword
inputs.description: Password for the operator id. Never logged or shown.

inputs.name: memberNumber
inputs.description: Member number to look up in the Member Inquiry Value box, with Search by set to Member Number.

inputs.name: shareId
inputs.description: Full share identifier exactly as it appears in the Share ID column of the SHARES / BALANCES grid. Must be the whole id — share ids share prefixes (100234-S0001 vs 100234-S0001-5).

outputs.name: shareBalance
outputs.description: Current balance of the requested share, from the Balance column of its row in the SHARES / BALANCES grid.

outputs.name: shareStatus
outputs.description: Status of the requested share, from the Status column of its row. Observed values: "OPEN" and "HOLD [HOLD]".

outputs.name: shareType
outputs.description: Share type of the requested share, from the Type column of its row (Regular Shares, Share Draft (Checking), Money Market, Certificate).

outputs.name: memberName
outputs.description: Name shown on the MEMBER RECORD header, useful to confirm the right member was opened.
